searchText: yeah this is definitely my concern I also don't think it's good to set a medium-term precedent that we're _that_ allergic to breaking backwards compatibility As the resident ossification and immutability maximalist, I strongly disagree with this. 😆 I would be 100% on board with _Ethereum Spiritual Successor_ not having self destruct as I agree that it is generally a bad idea. If I take my ossification & immutability maximalist hat off, then I think changing it to SENDALL is the most reasonable course of action, with special care given to implement one-off hack solutions to existing contracts that use it for actual self destruction (like within transaction self destructs are allowed).
